system.description:
As a Bonus action, you can select one willing creature within 30 feet of you wearing armor or wielding a weapon, and wrap them in your metallic chakra, spending 2 Ingots. When you do, for the next minute their armor or weapons bulk is increased by either +2, +4 or +6, your choice. The chosen bulk increase also provides some benefits for the duration.

Bulk +2. The target gains the Fortified property and a +2 bonus to their Armor Bonus.

Bulk +4. Same as Bulk +2 & a +2 bonus to their Constitution Saving throws.

Bulk +6. Same as Bulk +2 and a +2 bonus to their Strength and Constitution Saving throws.
